thought.text: All services return 404 even though the WARs deployed. Let me check the actual service endpoint paths defined in the workspaces:

reasoning_content:
All 404. The services are deployed, but the service paths may not match. Let's check what the actual service URL paths are. The guide lists URLs like `http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS...`. Let's look at the service definitions in the workspace and check the actual endpoint paths.

Let's check the service definitions in the workspace's services directory.

action.command: echo "=== wms workspace services ==="; ls /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/; echo "=== service name/url ==="; grep -rn "name=\|url=\|<Service" /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/*.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "name|url" | head; echo; echo "=== check the wms service file ==="; for f in /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/*.xml; do echo "--- $f ---"; grep -iE "name|url" "$f" | head -5; done
